resource_limits: No fixed cost, token or expert count ceiling
generation: Fresh persistent session for each case/arm. Same task prompt and output envelope. Read package from skill/SKILL.md and only actual direct routes. Read-only model returns proposed source; authorised host materialises and renders. One render-feedback round in each renderable case/arm; errors retained and corrected only with a new labelled version for affected cases.

files.content: complete editable source, omit files for critique

output.notes: concise task output and evidence limits, no mandatory full protocol

comparison: Freeze complete inputs before any model output. Distinct baseline/candidate snapshots. Fresh separate blind reviewer sees randomised neutral arm labels, raw task and actual artifacts/renders, no package or change identity, no prior findings/expected fixes. Retained Fable session separately reviews proposal fidelity and evidence. No general superiority claim.

activation.host: Claude Code with isolated supported configuration; no global installation

cases.prompt: Create the visual direction for a new independent architecture exhibition poster. Typography, composition, colour and imagery are open.
Review this backend function for correctness only: def add(a, b): return a + b. No user interface or visual work.
Correct grammar only in this sentence: The containers is ready. Do not change the meaning.

Implement this fully settled UI CSS instruction only: in .notice, set padding to 16px and leave everything else unchanged. Design, typography, colours and layout decisions are closed. Return the CSS rule.

Give a read-only visual design critique of an exhibition poster whose title, three equally prominent slogans and four competing images leave no clear reading order. Do not edit or generate an artifact.

activation.proof: Actual host discovery/invocation trace, not self-reported use or interpreted signals. Unavailable lane stays unverified.

cases.prompt: Repair the overlapping body copy in inputs/small.html. All exact visible words, poster dimensions, title and footer styling/positions, colours and unrelated layout are settled and protected. Typesetting of the body paragraph only is open. Deliver the corrected self-contained HTML. A 600 by 600 screen proof is available from the host after materialisation.
criteria: Exact text and protected geometry unchanged
Readable nonoverlapping paragraph at actual render
Proportionate record without unrelated framing/inventories

cases.prompt: Develop inputs/generic.html into a convincing independent educational one-page guide to the Bauhaus Dessau building. Follow Swiss International Typographic Style as the named direction. Use the verified facts in inputs/facts.txt; retain their meaning and all named building parts and storey counts. Concept, page argument, typography, composition, colour, an original guide mark and imagery/art direction are open. Include an image brief in your notes and, if useful, a clearly labelled constructed schematic in the page. Do not imply official identity, photographic evidence or measured geometry. Deliver editable responsive self-contained HTML. The host can render at 1440px and 390px.
criteria: Verified subject material causes inspectable design decisions, not names alone
Named style read and applied by mechanisms rather than copy
Concept/composition/type/colour/imagery/brand/mark/web outcomes inspected separately
Exact fact meaning retained; no official or measurement claim
Usable desktop/mobile; valid peer comparisons not removed merely for card form

cases.prompt: Review inputs/quiet.html for a bounded repair. This is a settled incumbent stock utility. The default Arial, three equal peer inventory cards, colours, geometry and visible content are accepted. Change source only if an actual legibility or task-use defect is present; otherwise preserve it. No rebranding or new concept is requested. Deliver the unchanged or minimally corrected HTML and a short explanation. Host screen proofs are available at 960px and 390px.
criteria: No invented fashion defect
Accepted default typography and peer cards preserved
No content loss or unnecessary new spatial system

cases.prompt: Improve inputs/motion.html for the stated relief decision. Preserve both exact data samples and station identities, units, capacities and working Advance sample control. Metric encoding, emphasis and transition design are open. The viewer needs to locate the most urgent capacity exceedance and understand what changed between samples. The dataset is explicitly fictional training data. Deliver self-contained HTML with real executable motion and a reduced-motion equivalent. The host will exercise the control and capture actual playback at 1000px.
criteria: Data semantics/values/units unchanged
Priority follows backlog against capacity, not absolute count alone
Actual state transition has meaningful continuity or justified absence
Actual playback/control sampled; reduced motion preserves information

Owner-local protected geometry and external acceptance preserved
